title: Multiple local news stations say the same thing verbatim
summary: A short compilation showing many local news anchors across different stations reading the same scripted statement verbatim. It is presented as evidence of centralized message control in local media.
why: Used as an example in threads about media consolidation and distrust of news, though many commenters cite it critically or only as a talking point.

quote.text: In the same vein and much more entertaining is this video that compares local news channels
